caption: Cascata delle Marmore, Terni
composition: Multi-tiered Marmore waterfall in forested cliffs · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the viewing terrace, the tourist faces the Marmore falls plunging in white tiers down the cliff right of center, mist rising where the water strikes. Steep forested walls close in on both sides, with the sky a strip of blue above. At 10:00 the sun is high and strong, sparkling on the falling water, and the railing of the overlook runs along the lower right of the frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Cascata delle Marmore under morning light
